topology.description: Logical topology of the Ademix haulage system as modelled by engine.py, plus the visual pit geometry of the 3D scene. The operational graph uses the register's units; the pit geometry is in scene units and is not a surveyed model.
topology.status: Fictional, simplified layout calibrated at the OpenMines route-distance scale. Not survey data.

edges.transfer: continuous at crusher rate while the bin is not empty

traffic_rules: Single lane in both directions: a stopped truck blocks traffic either way.
One speed limit applies to every moving truck; loaded and empty speeds are equal.
Excavator and dump bay each serve one truck at a time in arrival order.
not_available: Surveyed elevations, road grades and rolling resistance (no survey data; travel time uses a constant speed).
Alternative routes for rerouting (single road only).
topology.source_route_distances: fleet/route_distance_summary.csv compares the 3.2 km route with the 50 OpenMines load-to-dump and dump-to-load distances.

provenance.synthetic: telemetry/logs/* are synthetic simulator output, not measurements from a mine.
